text: 韩国金融当局周五紧急出手稳市，三个月内豁免140%信用担保比例维持义务。 特朗普称将“很快”决定是否重启对伊全面战争，外交斡旋同步提速。 日本政府养老投资基金因债券下跌遭遇六季度来首次亏损。 民主党计划调查苹果、Meta和马斯克，特朗普的硅谷盟友面临“清算”。 特斯拉宣布终止Cybertruck生产，马斯克将资源转向机器人与AI赛道。 莫德纳盘前大涨，公司第三季度营收超市场预期。 日经225指数收跌5.96%，沪指收跌1.1%，恒指收跌1.27%。
text_en: South Korean financial authorities stepped in urgently on Friday to stabilize the market, granting a three-month exemption from the obligation to maintain the 140% credit guarantee ratio. Trump said he will "soon" decide whether to restart a full-scale war against Iran, while diplomatic mediation is also accelerating. Japan's Government Pension Investment Fund suffered its first loss in six quarters due to falling bonds. Democrats plan to investigate Apple, Meta and Musk, and Trump's Silicon Valley allies face a "reckoning." Tesla announced it will end Cybertruck production, with Musk shifting resources to robotics and AI. Moderna surged premarket as the company's third-quarter revenue beat market expectations. The Nikkei 225 closed down 5.96%, the Shanghai Composite closed down 1.1%, and the Hang Seng Index closed down 1.27%.
